answer: Cosignatures are collected in ledge, verified in anchor, and reef names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 28 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. That bill is paid per identity, so 189 aliases cost 253 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
